# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c19 P27](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0027), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c19 P27](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0027), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Reverend Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>; Jo  <sub>[v3 c24 P22](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0022), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is not considered particularly handsome by conventional standards, though he possesses a radiant expression in his moments of happiness. He has a warm smile and an earnest manner when engaged in his duties.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P15](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0015), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

He is a deeply earnest, tender, and dedicated man, passionate about his religious calling. He exhibits a good-natured, forgiving demeanor, even when teased about his name or wife's casual language. He is wholeheartedly devoted to his spouse and cheerful in the face of sacrifice, willing to serve happily in humble conditions.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)_

## Traits

- Earnest  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>
- Tender  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>

## Abilities

- Eloquence in prayer and preaching  <sub>[v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve his congregation and carry out his ministry in the slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake studied theology at St. Columbia and served at the Prospect Point Mission Church during his college years. While there, he courted Philippa Gordon, who affectionately nicknamed him 'Jo.' Upon graduating, he committed himself to ministering in a poor urban parish on Patterson Street. He married Philippa in June following their graduation, and they embarked on a life together dedicated to his mission work. Later, he attended the wedding of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe at Green Gables, where he delivered a memorable wedding prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Background by volume

- Attended St. Columbia and studied theology to become a minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- Took charge of a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## Quotes

> I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn’t want to be a minister. But I came to see at last that it was the work given me to do—and God helping me, I shall try to do it.  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>
